name: Can cement stucco be applied over existing surfaces like brick or wood siding?
description: Cement stucco can be applied over existing surfaces like brick or wood siding, but it requires careful preparation and often an intervening lath system.

mainEntity.name: Can cement stucco be applied over existing surfaces like brick or wood siding?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, cement stucco can be applied over various existing surfaces, but proper preparation is crucial. For brick, a bonding agent or metal lath may be needed to ensure adhesion. When applying over wood siding, the siding usually needs to be removed, and a new substrate with building paper and metal lath installed to create a stable base for the stucco. Applying stucco directly over unsuitable surfaces can lead to cracking and failure. A professional assessment is vital.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cement stucco can be applied over existing surfaces like brick or wood siding, but it requires careful preparation and often an intervening lath system.
